newsitem.title: EGYPT: Russia's Primakov in Cairo to discuss Mideast peace.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Primakov in Cairo to discuss Mideast peace.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov arrived in Egypt on Wednesday on a Middle East tour intended to boost Russia's role as a co-sponsor of the Arab-Israeli peace process.
Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa met Primakov at Cairo airport. Primakov is expected to hold talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in the Sinai resort of Sharm el-Sheikh later on Wednesday.
Primakov has already held talks with Syrian and Lebanese officials and will also visit Jordan, Israel and the Palestinian self-rule territories.

He said at the start of his Middle East tour that Russia, a co-sponsor with the United States of the peace process, sought to be involved more actively in advancing the faltering talks between Israel and the Arabs.
